## The Power to Make It Real™

At Wolfspeed, we are the creators of the next-generation semiconductor technology that powers the
world’s most disruptive innovations. In other words, it’s our job to make humankind’s greatest
ambitions – real.

For us, making it real means making it the Wolfspeed way. We deliver unparalleled reliability on a
massive scale from the first U.S.-based silicon carbide corridor with end-to-end substrate and power
device fabrication to fulfill the world’s growing demand.

# Introducing ICeGaN® Technology

[Industry-First, Easy to Use e-Mode GaN][Industry-First, Easy to Use e-Mode GaN]
Industry-First, Easy to Use e-Mode GaN

Integrated Circuit Enhancement Mode GaN: a novel platform with state-of-the-art static and dynamic
performance increased ease-of-use and intelligent temperature control for the internal gate terminal
for enhanced gate reliability. Unlike other existing GaN devices, our smart ICeGaN® transistor can
be operated with standard silicon gate drivers and does not require negative voltages for shutdown,
hence removing the need for external, costly driving and clamping interfaces. Finally, a GaN power
transistor that can be operated like a MOSFET.

[read more][13]
[> 50% Energy Saved][> 50% Energy Saved]
> 50% Energy Saved

As electrification advances worldwide, so does the demand for highly efficient and innovative
solutions. ICeGaN® power devices can operate at much higher switching frequency with lower losses
and lower on-resistance than state-of-the-art silicon devices, delivering higher performance while
increasing energy savings by as much as 50%.

[read more][14]
[> 2x Smaller Electronics][> 2x Smaller Electronics]
> 2x Smaller Electronics

GaN transistors make it easy to operate many power topologies at a much higher frequency while still
achieving extremely high energy efficiency, thus enabling many applications to become smaller and
lighter. CGD's ICeGaN® integrates several features into their enhancement-mode GaN transistor to run
cooler and more reliably than ever before, hence complementing the obvious advantage of GaN vs
Silicon in achieving unprecedented power density.

[read more][15]

processing capacity of 120,000pcs 12inch silicon wafers.

* ### Business Wi-Fi & Wireless Networks
  
  Reliable wireless connectivity is critical to modern business operations. We design, install, and
  support secure indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi networks built for performance, coverage, and scalability.
  
  Our solutions include high-density Wi-Fi for offices and public spaces, long-range point-to-point
  and point-to-multipoint wireless bridges, cellular signal enhancement with repeaters and DAS
  systems, and IoT-ready networking for smart devices and sensors.

  mobile apps, and analytics, along with specialized solutions including emergency 911 compliant
  phones, long-range cordless systems, cellular-enabled voice failover, and both coin and cashless

  Need reliable network wiring for your business? We design and install complete network
  infrastructure and low-voltage cabling for offices, warehouses, campuses, medical facilities, and
  multi-building sites.
  
  Our team handles **structured cabling** from end to end, including **Cat6/Cat6A Ethernet cable
  runs**, **network drops**, **patch panels**, **server racks**, **MDF/IDF buildouts**, and clean,

  multi-mode) for high-speed backbones, long-distance links, and building-to-building connectivity,

  deliver a professional installation that is standards-based, documented, and built to scale.

## Wi-Fi, Network, and Security Services
* ### Business Wi-Fi & Wireless Networks
  
  Reliable wireless connectivity is critical to modern business operations. We design, install, and
  support secure indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi networks built for performance, coverage, and scalability.
  
  Our solutions include high-density Wi-Fi for offices and public spaces, long-range point-to-point
  and point-to-multipoint wireless bridges, cellular signal enhancement with repeaters and DAS
  systems, and IoT-ready networking for smart devices and sensors.
  
  From initial site surveys and network design to professional installation and ongoing support, we
  ensure your wireless infrastructure is fast, reliable, and built to grow with your business.
  
  CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO
* ### VoIP Phone Systems for Business
  
  Clear, reliable communication is essential for every business. Our VoIP phone solutions range from
  simple hosted systems to full enterprise-grade deployments designed for scalability, redundancy,
  and advanced call handling.
  
  We deliver feature-rich VoIP platforms with auto attendants, call routing, voicemail to email,
  mobile apps, and analytics, along with specialized solutions including emergency 911 compliant
  phones, long-range cordless systems, cellular-enabled voice failover, and both coin and cashless
  payphone services.
  
  From design and deployment to ongoing support and management, we ensure your phone system works
  seamlessly across offices, remote staff, and mission-critical environments.
  
  [**CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO**][27]
* ### Structured Cabling & Network Installation
  
  Need reliable network wiring for your business? We design and install complete network
  infrastructure and low-voltage cabling for offices, warehouses, campuses, medical facilities, and
  multi-building sites.
  
  Our team handles **structured cabling** from end to end, including **Cat6/Cat6A Ethernet cable
  runs**, **network drops**, **patch panels**, **server racks**, **MDF/IDF buildouts**, and clean,
  labeled cable management. We also install and terminate **fiber optic cabling** (single-mode and
  multi-mode) for high-speed backbones, long-distance links, and building-to-building connectivity,
  plus **coax** and other low-voltage systems as needed.
  
  Whether you are adding a few Ethernet ports or building a full network from the ground up, we
  deliver a professional installation that is standards-based, documented, and built to scale.
* ### Access Control & Door Entry Solutions
  
  Control who can enter your building and when. We design, install, and support commercial access
  control systems for offices, campuses, warehouses, healthcare facilities, and gated properties.
  
  Our access control solutions support key fobs, RFID cards, NFC mobile credentials, PIN codes,
  license plate recognition, and facial recognition, allowing you to manage doors, gates, and secure
  areas from a centralized platform. Access permissions can be assigned by user, location, or
  schedule, making it easy to grant, restrict, or revoke access at any time.
  
  From single-door systems to multi-site deployments, we provide professional installation, secure
  configuration, and ongoing support to ensure your access control system is reliable, scalable, and
  easy to manage.
* ### IP Cameras & Video Surveillance
  
  Protect your property, employees, and customers with professional IP security camera systems
  designed for reliability, clarity, and intelligent monitoring. We design, install, and support
  commercial video surveillance systems for businesses, campuses, medical facilities, and multi-site
  environments.
  
  Our solutions include high-definition IP cameras, secure network video recorders (NVRs), and
  scalable storage options with motion recording, AI-powered person and vehicle detection, license
  plate recognition, two-way audio, and remote viewing from desktop or mobile devices. Indoor and
  outdoor cameras are available, with options for night vision, wide-angle coverage, and long-term
  video retention.
  
  From camera placement and network design to power, storage, and ongoing support, we handle every
  aspect of your video surveillance system to ensure dependable performance and easy access when it
  matters most.
* ### Managed Services & 24/7 Customer Support
  
  Technology should support your business, not slow it down or leave you scrambling when something
  breaks. Our managed services are designed to fit your operation, not force you into an

  What sets us apart is our **24/7/365 **customer support team. When there is an issue, your staff

  Our support options are flexible, scalable, and built around your environment, budget, and

##### **¿QUE ES LA [INSTRUMENTACIÓN][66]?**


Es aquella que abarca un conjunto de elementos con los cuales se pueden medir, procesar, registrar
y/o convertir variables físico-químicas para que por medio de ellas se puedan optimizar y controlar
procesos industriales.

la aeronáutica, en la electrónica y en otras bases del conocimiento.

###### **¿QUE ES EL [CONTROL][68]?**


Es un área de la ingeniería que se encarga del control de un proceso en una condición determinada;
Un ejemplo claro de ello puede ser, mantener la temperatura de un sistema de calefacción, la
trayectoria realizada por un avión o la velocidad de un móvil en un valor establecido.

El [control industrial,][69] también denominada teoría de control, se encarga de estudiar el
comportamiento de los sistemas dinámicos, definiéndolos como «bloques» con una entrada y una salida.

Generalmente, la entrada al sistema es una señal  de tipo análoga o digital que se detecta en algún
punto del sistema.

Los bloques intercalados en un sistema completo, representan las  acciones  que afectan a la señal,
como la fricción en los actuadores, así como el efecto de los elementos de control interpuestos, los
reguladores.
